status: FROZEN 2026-11-12 before any Test 7 run. Changes only by dated addendum.
label: TRANSFER TEST, not a replication: Li et al.'s exact QRC design (10 qubits, 7 inputs, 3 lags, their 100 coupling matrices, QR1 and QR2 readouts) applied to monthly commodity realized volatility.
data: HG: data/daily_long/flagged_v2/HG_F_1d.csv, ret_clean. Others: data/daily_multi/<A>.csv close-to-close log returns (same cleaning as long_prereg_multiasset.json). Months 2000-10..2024-12; the 2025-26 holdout is never read. Monthly RV = log sqrt(sum of squared daily log returns in the month), as in Li et al.
inputs_7: RV, RV_q (mean of RV over months t-2..t), RV_a (t-11..t), monthly log return of the asset, RV of a driver commodity (CL for every asset except CL, which uses HG), log of monthly mean VIX close, monthly log return of DX-Y.NYB. QRC uses lags t-1..t-3 of these to forecast RV_t, exactly as the authors' design.
scaling: Min-max on the first training window only (no look-ahead), clipped: RV-type to [-1, 0], returns to [-1, 1], VIX and driver RV to [0, 1], matching the authors' ranges. Target = scaled RV.
split: Test 2015-01..2024-12 (120 one-step forecasts). Rolling window = all usable months before 2015-01 (fixed length). Validation = 2012-01..2014-12 (36 forecasts) with window length shortened by 36. All selection and tuning on validation only.
models: Same families and settings as prereg_li_audit_T2T3.json: QR1/QR2 over 100 instances (QR_val = validation-selected), QR_J0, ESNtuned_w-p, RandTrig-p, RFF-p (each validation-selected over 100), Trig2 (validation-tuned ridge), AR3, HAR(1,3,12). p = 10 vs QR1, 20 vs QR2.
loss: primary: squared error on the scaled log RV; secondary: per-period QLIKE on variance exp(2 logRV) after unscaling

rules.per_asset: QR_val vs each of the 7 comparators: ratio, stationary-bootstrap 95% interval (block 6, 5000), Diebold-Mariano Newey-West lag 4, Holm over the 7. Quantum edge in an asset only if better than all 7 with Holm p < 0.05 (strict rule).
rules.overall: A transfer of the published claim is supported for a design only if it shows a quantum edge in at least 5 of 8 assets; otherwise 'not supported on commodities'. Copper reported first and on its own.
rules.descriptive: Rank and distribution of the 100 instances' test losses per asset; Hansen SPA of the 100 instances vs HAR per asset.

power_caveat: 120 test months per asset is fewer than the paper's 245; Test 6 (MDE) will quantify what this design can detect.
student_predictions: Not provided. The student asked the assistant to proceed without stating predictions (2026-11-12).
